WITH account_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id,
    AVG(t.amount) as avg_trans_amount
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
),
region_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3 as region,
    AVG(aa.avg_trans_amount) as region_figure
  FROM account_averages aa
  JOIN district d ON aa.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
all_region_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_figure) as overall_avg
  FROM region_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.region,
  ra.region_figure,
  ra.region_figure - ara.overall_avg as exceeds,
  ra.region_figure / ara.overall_avg as ratio
FROM region_averages ra
CROSS JOIN all_region_average ara
WHERE ra.region_figure > ara.overall_avg
ORDER BY ra.region
